name: Necromancer Deathly Chill shortens Ice Barrage's cast and barrage by 25% (#1110)
contract: Deathly Chill 805424 is a Necromancer Rime talent (CharacterAdvancement 30619, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 60 Rime, TalentEssenceCost 1). Its client description reads 'Reduces the channel and cast time of Ice Barrage by $s1%.' All three effects are SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with BasePoints -26 + DieSides 1 = -25 and EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0x40, 0) in SpellFamilyName 29: MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME) and 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME). Ice Barrage (801760 and ranks 501992-501999, family flags 0, 0x40, 0) is a 2000 ms cast (CastingTimeIndex 5) that puts a 1000 ms aura (DurationIndex 36) on the enemy: effect 0 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE every 250 ms (the volleys, 803779) and effect 1 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL every 999 ms (the entomb, 804328). Its 'channel' is that barrage aura. Unit::ModSpellCastTime, Aura::CalcMaxDuration and AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic apply the caster's modifiers, so with the talent the cast takes 1500 ms and a fresh barrage aura lasts 750 ms with a 187 ms volley period (250 * 0.75, truncated to whole milliseconds), against 1000 ms and 250 ms without it. The first observation of a fresh aura is at most one world step after it lands.
